name: Indoor inspection drone Drone-01
description: Showcase example: an indoor inspection drone whose mission supervisor is a verified Digital Twin. The twin plans over partial building knowledge, learns the building through the environment API, replans when new information invalidates its route, and records every semantic decision in a tamper-evident ledger.

blueprint.name: Indoor Inspection Drone
blueprint.description: Indoor inspection drone with a verified mission-supervisor twin (co-simulation with the drone simulator).

ontology.name: Indoor drone domain
ontology.description: Domain theory shared by the flight controller (firmware units) and the mission twin (SI units): bridge axioms, battery energy, mission parameters.

pt_interpretation.name: Flight controller interpretation (I_P)
pt_interpretation.description: Meaning of the flight controller's modes and events in the domain theory.

dt_interpretation.name: Mission twin interpretation (I_D)
dt_interpretation.description: Meaning of the mission supervisor's locations and events in the domain theory.

pt_model.name: PT view: flight controller (FlightControllerPT)
pt_model.description: Timed-automaton view of the flight-controller firmware (V_P).

dt_model.name: DT view: mission supervisor (MissionSupervisorDT)
dt_model.description: Behavioural Digital Twin executed by the kernel (V_D).

instances.name: Drone-01
instances.description: Behavioural Digital Twin of Drone-01's mission supervisor (V_D): mission modes, admissible decisions and their timing, executed by the verified semantic kernel; aligned with the flight controller's view (V_P).
